requests.description: Must contain exactly one Digital Credentials API request.

protocol.description: The DC API protocol. Only the signed variant `openid4vp-v1-signed` is supported.

request.description: The signed OID4VP request object (a JAR), as a compact JWS. It MUST have `typ` header `oauth-authz-req+jwt`, be signed with ES256 by a key whose JWK is registered on your OAuth Application, and carry the OID4VP request claims: `iss` (equal to `client_id`), `aud` (the Proof presentation issuer), `client_id`, `response_type` (`vp_token`), `response_mode` (`dc_api`), `scope`, `login_hint`, and `nonce`. For the intermediary flow, also include `expected_origins`. To let AI agents poll for the result instead, set `expected_origins` to exactly the agents trust list (`/.well-known/agents-trust-list` on this API host) and omit `response_uri`.

return_uri.description: Optional. Enables the x401 intermediary return channel (https://x401.proof.com/spec/latest/#return-channel). When present, Proof POSTs the Verifiable Credential Presentation to this URI instead of the request object's `response_uri`. Its origin must be listed in the request object's `expected_origins`, and the request object must not itself specify a `response_uri`. Omit it when the request object's `expected_origins` is the agents trust list: Proof then keeps the result for the calling agent to poll at `result_polling_uri`.
